Start here

ReboundOps is a local-first developer preview for software professionals navigating a layoff, career pivot or job search. Start with a fictional example, review your experience, choose a direction to test and organize the search.

Install locallyInstall and open the integrated workspace.Build a plan →Review evidence and choose a practical next action.Work your search →Discover roles and track applications.Contribute →Find the code and run the right checks.

What runs where

This website publishes documentation and product information. The recovery app and job-search workspace run on your machine. The integrated workspace connects their navigation; recovery records and job-search files are not automatically synchronized.

Core recovery works without AI. The app is intended for single-user localhost use; it has no hosted accounts or multi-user authentication. Keep the API on loopback and do not expose it through a tunnel or public reverse proxy.

Engineering checks exist, but external participant validation and manual assistive-technology evaluation remain open gates. Read the roadmap ↗ for current readiness.
